answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and price every new identity through a prism of escalating deposits: the first identity is cheap, each additional one costs a growing delta more, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand times the stake. Peers then mirror-check random samples of claimed work against on-chain receipts; a failed check slashes the stake and burns the identity, turning sybil scale into a linear expense instead of free multiplication.
